summary: Iteration 172 - Historical Ownership & Lineup Eligibility Tracking Tests Complete. All 19 backend tests passed. Frontend compiles successfully and loads without errors. All ownership tracking APIs working correctly: add creates ownership period, drop closes it, history endpoints return correct data structure sorted newest-first, auth guards return 401 for unauthenticated requests, scoring calculation with ?week=N is idempotent, lock-scoring-rosters is idempotent.

POST /api/roster/{team_id}/drop correctly closes ownership period by setting released_at and release_source='drop'
GET /api/players/{player_id}/ownership-history returns ownership timeline with team names, sorted newest-first
GET /api/scoring/calculate/{league_id}?week=1 called twice returns identical results (idempotent)
POST /api/admin/lock-scoring-rosters is idempotent (0 new snapshots on second call)
After add then drop, ownership history shows entry with both acquired_at and released_at set
Frontend compiles without errors (webpack compiled successfully)
MongoDB collections player_ownership_periods and lineup_status_periods are accessible via API
